content.title: VeriSign (VRSN) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: VeriSign delivered both growth in a domain name base and solid financial performance during the third quarter.  At the end of September, the domain name base for .com and .net totaled 171.9 million domain names, up 1.4% year-over-year.  During the quarter, we returned $72 million through dividends and $215 million through share repurchases for a total return to shareholders of $287 million.
